transcript: What would happen if you used rice water on your face every day for two weeks? My friend, your skin would begin a quiet transformation. Rice water may look simple, but it carries ancient nutrients, inositol, niacin, B6, B2, vitamins that guide the skin back toward balance. These nutrients help reduce excess melanin, softening dark spots and brightening areas that have become dull from stress, sun or pollution. Day by day, your face begins to look clearer, calmer, more alive. You'll also notice your skin becoming softer with more natural hydration. Rice water doesn't force the glow. It supports the skin so it can glow on its own. And if you ferment the rice water, its power grows. More lactic acid forms matching the pH of your skin. Good bacteria and yeast appear, strengthening your microbiome, reducing breakouts and tightening the pores. This is why generations before us used rice water as a beauty ritual, not because it was fancy, but because it worked gently, consistently and naturally. Healing does not have to be complicated. Sometimes the simplest rituals bring the clearest results.
